provenance: SYNTHETIC. `Job attempt duration exceeded timeout` is the statusReason AWS Batch records when attemptDurationSeconds elapses; this estate has never captured one, and the exit code such a document carries is NOT known -- 0 is used here because it is the value that makes the document unrecognisable to every arm, which is the whole point of the fixture.
why_it_is_here: THE DEFAULT, PROVEN BY EVALUATION. Every other fixture matches some arm, so until this one existed the strongest safety property in the lane -- 'an unrecognised shape is NOT tolerated' -- rested on a string assertion over the HCL. A rendered-rule mutant that flipped the fetch Default to RecordSourceFailureFetch turned exactly one pin red, and that pin read the Default as text. This document reaches it for real: no ExitCode above the signal floor, no roster prefix in any reason field, and a StatusReason that is not 'Essential container in task exited', so the ran-to-an-exit arm cannot fire either.
